card.text: Red giant 20.43 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Aldebaran is a red giant 20.43 parsecs away and 44 times the Sun’s radius, measured as the Moon passed in front of it. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a relatively calibrated spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
